name: bcis-billing-system
description: BCIS Subscription Billing and Collection System - A comprehensive desktop application for Bukidnon Cable and Internet Services

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bcis/shared run build && pnpm --filter @bcis/db run build && pnpm --filter @bcis/api run build && pnpm --filter @bcis/desktop run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @bcis/desktop run lint && pnpm --filter @bcis/api run lint && pnpm --filter @bcis/shared run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bcis/desktop run test && pnpm --filter @bcis/api run test && pnpm --filter @bcis/shared run test
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @bcis/shared run test && pnpm --filter @bcis/api run test:unit
